posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
If we can get CosmiTron to flip this turn, I'd prefer doing the Interpolation Beam.  If he doesn't flip, the drone. 

I don't think it's going to be hard to deal 4 more damage, considering Elbow Smash, Flak Cannon and Fleet of Foot/Sonic Vortex.  Only thing we'd have to worry about is having Haka deal damage this turn, so that Bunker can get around the Adaptive Plating Subroutine.  

Sound good to everyone?
